title: Fail-closed Staging backup-policy inventory evidence state

phases.objective: Distinguish an independently verified empty Staging policy census from unverified registry access, without changing backup execution or approval authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Read-only Staging backup readiness CLI with absent independent SELECT-only reader
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Unverified policy inventory returns an explicit evidence blocker and null count, not a false assertion that zero rows were read; actual verified empty inventory is reported as missing.
steps: Check dedicated backup-reader availability without falling back to runtime_app or root.
Run fail-closed authority assessment against unverified policy inventory and assert it cannot be considered ready.
Assert verified empty inventory is distinguished as actual missing policy, and unverified forged policy data is not accepted.
Check read-only CLI results and redact private credentials.
Maintain synthetic reader-grant and preflight authority regression coverage.
assertions: Unknown inventory is never displayed as a verified zero policy count.
Backup/restore and QA writes remain blocked without owner-signed policy plus real encrypted backup/restore evidence.
No database DDL, GRANT, live backup, QA principal, Production deployment or mutation is performed.
